facts.fact: The author built his own Claude Code-like AI coding agent (a 'harness') in Go, using the Anthropic API, to learn how AI harnesses work.
facts.trap: It was built in Python/TypeScript, or with the OpenAI API.
facts.note: Auto-captions write 'Cloud Code' and 'Antropic'; correct names are Claude Code and Anthropic. Providers are pluggable (OpenAI mentioned as an option), but the project was built on the Anthropic API.

evidence.quote: Hice un proyecto utilizando Go en el que utilizando la API de Antropic implementé todo el arnés alrededor de la LLM.

facts.fact: He explains the agentic loop: the model either returns a final answer or a tool call; the tool is executed and its result sent back to the model until a final response, all inside an outer REPL loop that waits for user input.

evidence.quote: si es que sí, ejecutamos la tool, ¿vale? En esta línea de aquí es donde haríamos la ejecución, y volvemos a llamar al modelo con el resultado.

facts.fact: In this video he adds multi-agent orchestration: a spawn tool launches subagents in the background, each in its own Git worktree and goroutine, reporting their status to the main loop and shown in the terminal UI.
facts.trap: Subagents run on separate machines or share the same working copy.
facts.note: Inspired by agent orchestrator apps the captions call 'Orca' and 'Herder' (names may be misheard).

evidence.quote: Empieza un agente en background con su propio work tree de Git y vuelve inmediatamente.

facts.fact: Main takeaway: agents aren't magic, just a wrapper around LLM calls; products like Claude Code sell mainly the UI/experience, and the best way to learn is to build things yourself step by step. His harness is for learning, not production.
facts.trap: He presents his agent as a production-ready replacement for Claude Code.

evidence.quote: un agente de IA no deja de ser esto, un wrapper a llamadas a un LLM.

facts.fact: He points to his 'Build Your Own Harness' website and repository, with step-by-step lessons (also in Spanish) and exercises.

evidence.quote: realicé un repositorio y una página web que se llama Build your own harness o Build your own coding agent

facts.trap: Presents Build Your Own Harness as the project shown in the video or part of it; it is a separate learning site he promotes.

review.note: Facts confirmed by a viewer. Viewer prefers gemma3:4b's baseline summary by far: qwen3:4b's mixes up the Build Your Own Harness site (a separate site he promotes) with the harness project the video shows.
